task: Verify all 30 key-protocol fixtures after replacing Team B's interim Gate 10 assertion.
observation: The key fixture runner's --activate option selects expected-result checks but does not select the staged ABI. Invoking it without MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 produced 13 default-v9 fail-closed mismatches, including RECORD_MAP_KEY_UNSUPPORTED, although the staged implementation was healthy.
impact: The first activation result was not valid evidence of a staged regression; the environment had to be identified and the suite rerun.

resolution.summary: The runner's usage text now states the required staged ABI environment; the explicit v10 rerun passed all 30 fixtures.

task: Execute all 11 ABI-v10 cross-crate integration scenarios after H3 checked IR support.
observation: The initial staged harness had 5 PASS, 3 FAIL, and 3 BLOCKED: Scenarios 2-4 kept provider source available and used unbound raw Box annotations, Scenario 6 passed on one unexecuted build, Scenario 7 never built its provider, Scenario 8 used record match-consume syntax, and Scenario 10 had a mutation that changed no bytes.
impact: A reported PASS could overstate source-free execution, while BLOCKED results hid fixture and harness setup errors; exact E3 evidence required rebuilding the acceptance path.
evidence: MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/phase25/integration/cross_crate_harness.py --all --json: initial 5 PASS/3 FAIL/3 BLOCKED
MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/phase25/integration/cross_crate_harness.py --all --json: 11 PASS/0 BLOCKED/0 FAIL
MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/phase25/integration/cross_crate_harness.py --all --profile release --json: 11 PASS/0 BLOCKED/0 FAIL

resolution.summary: The harness now pins repository-local tools, removes provider source before consumer checks, executes exact native outputs and the H3 two-consumer private chain, and asserts structured provenance, ownership, and mutation diagnostics in both profiles.

task: Run the strict Phase 25 release ledger on the staged compiler SHA.
observation: The original --strict command read only acceptance_matrix.json. It reported 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 51 BLOCKED, and 10 NOT IMPLEMENTED on a checkout where G2 11/11, key 30/30, Team B 23/23, and E3 debug/release 11/11 executed successfully. Its PASS evidence check accepted any existing Git commit, without executing a gate or binding it to the current HEAD.
impact: The ledger could lag real integration progress and a stale existing SHA plus plausible text could falsely claim a gate PASS.
evidence: MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 python3 tests/phase25/integration/run_acceptance.py --strict --json: exit 1 and 0/62 PASS at d5cb5e370f09dc99efb3791ad72432653b9ef7d4
MOSS_STAGED_ABI=v10 python3 tests/phase25/integration/run_acceptance.py --live --json: all four mapped suites execute on the staging checkout

resolution.summary: Added a live same-HEAD proof path with exact case mappings, clean-tree guard, serial suite execution, and fail-closed parser self-tests; unmapped gates remain open.
